newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA M1 UP 2.54 PCT, M2 RISES 1.95 PCT IN WEEK.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA M1 UP 2.54 PCT, M2 RISES 1.95 PCT IN WEEK.

text.p: Bulgarian M1 money supply edged up
to 145.6 billion levs on August 23 from 142 billion levs on
August 16 and M2 rose to 791.2 billion levs from 776.1 billion
levs, preliminary central bank figures showed.
Total broad money grew 2.22 percent to 818.9 billion levs
as lev-denominated broad money edged up 1.02 percent to 483.7
billion levs and dollar-denominated broad money rose 4.0
Hard currency-denominated term deposits of companies and
individuals totalled $ 1.592 billion on August 23, up $14
But dollar-denominated deposits of individuals have fallen
to $758 million on August 23 from $762 million the previous
Lev-denominated term deposits of companies and individuals
inched up to 279 billion levs from 278.7 billion levs.
